page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top centre ("EMBLEMA"), then full-width title heading "ILIACOS INTRA MVROS PECcatur, & extra" in two lines. Below: a large woodcut engraving occupying the centre. Under the engraving: a four-line verse set in italic, centred. At lower right: a catchword "Fabu-" alone at the right foot. Page number "34" at top left.

l.i: Inq; sua nemo fert statione vires.
Acceleres igitur reditum, bone Christe, redemptor
Adsis, & metam in secula pone malis.

page.notes: The woodcut shows a city wall scene: a figure on a ladder and scaffold at a church, a man with a pickaxe breaking at the wall, a figure on a barrel, and a labourer with a hoe in a vineyard at lower left; the word "CYRIA" is visible on the building at right. The first verse line is printed "Perrea" in the scan, probably for "Perrea" as printed; the second line is "Inq; sua nemo fert statione vires." The heading's hyphenation "PEC-catur" is kept as printed. The catchword "Fabu-" is at the right foot.
